statements.markdown: **Lemma 7.7.** Let $\alpha\in\mathcal K$ and $S=S(\alpha)$. There exists a constant $C$, which depends only on $C_{\mathrm a}$, such that for every $v\in L^2_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb R;X)$ of period $1$ in $\theta$ the field $\mathcal C_\alpha v$ of (7.13) belongs to $\mathcal H$ and $\|\mathcal C_\alpha v\|_{\mathcal H}\le C\,\|\nabla v\|_{\mathcal H}$. If $v$ is $\Gamma$-invariant, so is $\mathcal C_\alpha v$. The operator $\mathcal C_\alpha\mathcal T_S^{-1}$ from $\mathcal H_{\mathrm{div}}$ to $\mathcal H$ is compact.
